title: New grant category for Kultur och fritid

articles.subject: New grant category for Kultur och fritid
articles.body:
Hi,

The council decided in June that cultural associations will apply through Grantly from the autumn round instead of by paper. We need a new category with its own form, its own decision template and its own budget ceiling.

Who do we talk to about the form design? Our unit for culture and leisure wants three extra questions on the form.

Best regards,
Anna Lind

articles.subject: Re: New grant category for Kultur och fritid
articles.body:
Hi Anna,

Happy to hear it. The category itself is configuration and I can set it up in a day once we have the form fields. The three extra questions are fine as long as they are of the standard field types.

Could you send the field list with type and whether each is mandatory? Then we do it in your test environment first and you review it there.

Best,
Mia

articles.subject: New grant category for Kultur och fritid
articles.body: Waiting on the field list from the culture unit. Anna says it is with them. Reminder set for the 26th; if nothing by then this will not make the autumn round and someone needs to say that out loud.
